panels.title: My routine
points: أَتَنَاوَلُ الفَطُورَ ثُمَّ أَبْدَأُ دُرُوسِي عَبْرَ الإِنْتَرْنِتِ
فِي المَسَاءِ أُرَاجِعُ القُرْآنَ وَأَنَامُ مُبَكِّرًا

model.title: Compare my routine and my brother's.

parts.text: هُمْ (my cousins) يَدْرُسُونَ فِي مَدْرَسَةٍ قَرِيبَةٍ.

blocks.text: Fill both columns from memory, then check the first against the table above.

questions.q: Conjugate يَكْتُبُ for نَحْنُ and هُمْ.
Translate: I usually go to bed at ten.
Core: Write 80 words on a typical weekday (portal response box), with five verbs, three frequency words and the prayers.
questions.a: Marked for range of verbs, frequency words, time phrases and accuracy.

questions.q: Extend: Add three sentences about another person (أَخِي، أُمِّي، أَصْدِقَائِي) with the right verb forms.
questions.a: For example: أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ الغَدَاءَ. أَصْدِقَائِي يَلْعَبُونَ بَعْدَ المَدْرَسَةِ.

questions.q: Stretch (Group A): identify the حَرْفُ المُضَارَعَةِ in four verbs from your answer and name the person each shows.
questions.a: For example: نَـ in نُصَلِّي (we); يَـ in يَلْعَبُونَ (they)
B) تَدْرُسِينَ. أَنْتِ takes تَـ ... ـِينَ: تَدْرُسِينَ.

questions.q: 'They study': A) يَدْرُسُونَ B) نَدْرُسُ C) تَدْرُسُ
Big question: how does the present tense change for different people?
questions.a: Prefixes (أَ، تَ، يَ، نَ) and suffixes (ـِينَ، ـُونَ) show who does the action.
